releases.notes:
# Floyd Addons 5.6

## Added

- Collapsible modules: only the enable row appears initially. A plain rotating arrow beside the switch slides settings open and closed inside a full-width card. Toggles work independently, and search opens matching settings automatically.
- Sack Supercraft in QoL, with clickable regular and enchanted sack names through `/supercraft` and a button inside supported sacks.
- A rounded sack panel with spaced upgrade icons, smooth X markers for ignored outputs, and a clear "No upgrades" message for sacks without crafting upgrades.
- Optional snow inside Floyd's settings GUI, off by default and controlled from Theme.

## Supercraft fixes and improvements

- Normal sacks upgrade materials once into their direct enchanted counterpart. Wheat becomes Enchanted Wheat, sugar cane becomes Enchanted Sugar, and sunflowers become Enchanted Sunflowers; bread and sunflower oil recipes are excluded.
- Enchanted sacks continue through supported resource compression tiers. Gemstones compact Rough → Flawed → Fine and stop at Fine.
- Read gemstone grade counts separately instead of treating the weighted "Stored" total as Rough gemstones, fixing repeated recipes and stalled upgrades.
- Added Chili Pepper → Stuffed Chili Pepper to the normal Combat Sack.
- Ignore lists display upgrade targets and prevent crafting into ignored outputs. Saved exclusions and `/supercraft except` and `/supercraft allow` remain supported.
- Shift-click the real golden pickaxe to select the maximum, verify its updated amount and recipe costs, then craft and wait for confirmation before continuing. Decorative gemstone glyphs no longer enter recipe commands.
- Supercraft controls and bottom-right notifications keep the GUI font even when the Font module is off.

## Visual improvements

- Matched the title-screen background to Midnight Silver while keeping distinct blue, violet, and silver aurora ribbons.
- Added layered snow behind the title-screen buttons, with separate depths, sizes, speeds, and drift, plus its own Theme toggle.
- Removed snow stretching and grid artifacts, softened edges, and prevented animation-clock jumps.

## Downloads and validation

Built and tested for Minecraft 26.1, 26.1.2, and 26.2, with fresh offline client checks for crafting and the settings GUI. Live-server compatibility remains unverified. Fabric API and Fabric Language Kotlin are required. Choose the matching runtime JAR; updated SHA-256 checksums are attached.

Supercraft stops when confirmation is missing or a menu is unsupported. The server's maximum may include matching materials from inventory and other storage. Forge, trade, and equipment recipes are excluded.

# Floyd Addons 5.5

## Added
- Searchable block and mob lists with model previews, plus a live Cone Hat preview in settings.
- Companion conversations, optional gameplay comments, and smoother speech preparation and playback.

## Fixed and improved
- Improved Auto Experiments startup, focus handling, and reopening the Experimentation Table between games.
- Corrected Chronomatron and Ultrasequencer reward tracking and Ironman experience-bottle consumption.
- Improved Superpairs scouting, immediate matching of known priority rewards, and Instant Find choices. Priority is ultra-rare books, rare items, then other books.
- Improved equipment/player-head texture compatibility and transparency.
- Kept custom fonts active for the scoreboard and inventory HUD.
- Protected existing settings from being overwritten after an incomplete configuration load.
- Added a matching sidebar divider above Edit HUD and improved companion rendering efficiency.

## Downloads
Choose the JAR matching Minecraft **26.1**, **26.1.2**, or **26.2**. **Fabric API** and **Fabric Language Kotlin** are required.

All three targets passed their builds and automated checks. SHA-256 checksums are attached alongside the three runtime JARs.

releases.notes:
# Floyd Addons 5.4

## Added in this release update
- **Tom Pearl** joins Verity and Randy as a third companion, with a photo-inspired pet and separate local Natural voice.
- Four Tom expression frames cover idle, thinking, listening, and speaking. His toothless speaking mouth reacts to voice playback, with the same smooth idle movement and draggable momentum as the other pets.
- **Test Voice**, model switches, and the first world join play the original prerecorded greeting: **Hi my name is Tom Pearl**. Later server/world rejoins do not replay the join introduction.
- Tom's voice uses a continuous recording reference and revised sampling for smoother, less robotic delivery. Existing Verity and Randy voices remain unchanged.

## Original 5.4 changes: Agent companions
- New **Agent** sidebar section with ChatGPT and Claude account sign-in, connection status, and sign-out. Credit: Kirk Client.
- **Verity** and **Randy** pets (now also joined by Tom Pearl) with thinking, listening, speaking, and idle expressions; smooth bobbing, draggable momentum, and limited sideways wobble.
- Theme-matched chat history and a compact bottom-right bubble that expands smoothly for conversation, microphone previews, and spoken replies.
- Natural local speech with text revealed during playback, model-specific voices, independent voice volume, and improved Randy delivery.
- Prerecorded introductions on the first world join per launch, model switches, and Test Voice, with shorter Verity pauses and adjusted pronunciation. Later world/server rejoins do not replay the join intro.
- Hold **Left Alt** to speak, choose a connected microphone, and see live Whisper transcription. Stop cancels the current response without signing out.
- AI connections and conversation survive world/server switches; leaving a world cancels the current response or recording.
- ChatGPT login falls back from Windows credential storage when a token is too large. The bubble shows **Not signed in** when disconnected.
- Updated Codex CLI discovery and account-default model selection fix replies failing immediately after preparation. Reply errors remain visible in chat.
- Web research through the connected provider and **gameplay analysis on request**. Explicit screen-analysis requests attach one Minecraft screenshot; ordinary chat does not capture gameplay.

## Original 5.4 changes: interface
- **Midnight Silver** is now the default for new installations and appears first in the theme list. Existing theme selections remain saved.
- Pets render above HUD elements, including while editing the HUD or using Minecraft chat.
- Chat buttons use the same click sound as the main settings controls.
- Companion chat follows the selected Floyd theme, with smoother open/close transitions and corrected control bounds.

## Release maintenance
- Checked-in release notes now provide this complete summary, and CI preserves existing descriptions when a notes file is absent.
- Updated jars are attached below for all three supported Minecraft versions, with SHA-256 checksums.

## Requirements and downloads
Choose the jar matching Minecraft **26.1**, **26.1.2**, or **26.2**. Fabric API and Fabric Language Kotlin are required.

Agent account sign-in requires the corresponding **Codex CLI** or **Claude Code** installation and an eligible account. Local Natural speech and Whisper transcription require a separately installed Python runtime and model dependencies; those large dependencies are not bundled in these jars. Provider plan limits apply. See [Agent companion documentation](https://github.com/lunabot9/FloydAddons/blob/v5.4/docs/agent-companion.md) for behavior and runtime requirements.

releases.notes:
# FloydAddons 5.3

A fully independent Floyd settings screen, customizable themes, animated procedural skies,
and cleaner HUD rendering for Minecraft 26.1, 26.1.2, and 26.2.

## Menus and themes

- Floyd's primary UI now runs as its own screen. Its branding, theme, sounds, and HUD behavior are isolated from the actual OneConfig menu.
- Added a bottom-left Theme page with six presets: Golden Amber, Nebula Violet, Glacier Blue, Emerald Grove, Rose Quartz, and Midnight Silver, plus custom color controls.
- Added Edit HUD above Theme; closing the HUD editor returns to Floyd's settings screen.
- Polished rounded sidebar hover states, sliding category/preset highlights, preset outlines, outer borders, and the full-height divider.
- Improved search, slower smooth scrolling, descriptive action labels, and inline previous/next arrows for file selections.
- Retained opening/closing fades without Floyd menu music or opening/closing sounds. Fixed the opening key being typed into focused text fields and unwanted HUD-editor previews from other mods.

## HUD and notifications

- Added Notifier under Render: animated bottom-right toggle notifications with duration, visible-card limit, menu visibility, and centered plus/minus badges.
- Added global and per-panel border switches. New panel styles default to Box blur at strength 20.
- Improved frosted backgrounds with lighter tint, dense separable blur to remove sampling-grid artifacts, and a smoother, lighter exterior fade that stays outside panel edges.
- Custom fonts are off by default for new installs. Renamed Scoreboard Larp to Scoreboard Name while migrating saved values.

## Custom skies

- Added six animated 360-degree procedural skies under Render: Golden Aurora, Nebula, Emerald Aurora, Crimson Eclipse, Sapphire Galaxy, and Rose Clouds.
- Skies are generated in shaders, rather than animated photographs. Golden Aurora uses a starfield without the menu's water, and Rose Clouds has sparser cloud banks and clearer gaps.
- Added Performance, Balanced, and High rendering quality. Balanced renders expensive gas/cloud layers at reduced resolution while keeping stars sharp; lighter skies remain native resolution.
- Fixed sky/terrain flickering and preserved world depth and renderer state.

## Other fixes

- Corrected detached-camera/freecam frustum positioning so terrain culling follows the camera.
- Config loading stays quiet instead of generating toggle notifications.

## Downloads and requirements

Choose the jar matching your Minecraft version:

- `FloydAddons-5.3-26.1.jar`
- `FloydAddons-5.3-26.1.2.jar`
- `FloydAddons-5.3-26.2.jar`
- `SHA256SUMS-v5.3.txt` contains SHA-256 checksums for all three jars.

Requires Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, matching Fabric API, and Fabric Language Kotlin 1.14.1+kotlin.2.4.20 or newer. Settings libraries are bundled. Existing Floyd settings are preserved.

All three targets were built and tested locally. UI, HUD, notifier, and sky changes were also checked in the isolated Minecraft 26.1.2 client; this is separate from the three-version build verification.

releases.notes:
# FloydAddons 5.2

FloydAddons 5.2 introduces the new primary settings menu and improves SkyBlock
resource-pack compatibility for Minecraft 26.1, 26.1.2, and 26.2.

- Replaced the legacy primary menu with native settings controls, styled in the
  main menu's warm brown and amber palette with a stacked Floyd Addons wordmark.
- Simplified navigation to Render, Hiders, Camera, Cosmetic, QoL, and Misc.
- The primary menu opens with N or `/fa`; Right Shift opens the secondary ClickGUI.
- ClickGUI category panels open expanded by default, including compact layouts.
- Removed ambient menu music and the menu opening sound while preserving other UI sounds.
- Fixed cached settings frames disappearing during navigation or after reopening.
- Improved SkyBlock pack removal by retaining complete fallback models and textures,
  avoiding missing textures and inappropriate paper fallbacks for unregistered items.
- Includes the latest upstream player-head fixes, recording identity fixes, and
  support for user-provided player model files.

Downloads:

- `FloydAddons-5.2-26.1.jar` for Minecraft 26.1
- `FloydAddons-5.2-26.1.2.jar` for Minecraft 26.1.2
- `FloydAddons-5.2-26.2.jar` for Minecraft 26.2
- `SHA256SUMS-v5.2.txt` for artifact verification

Requires Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, a matching Fabric API, and
Fabric Language Kotlin 1.14.1+kotlin.2.4.20 or newer. The native settings libraries
are included in the runtime jars.
